description: This file defines the VideoDialog class for handling video embedding dialogs in the Summernote WYSIWYG editor, including methods for initializing the dialog UI, creating video nodes from URLs, and managing user interactions.

classes.name: VideoDialog
classes.description: Class managing the video insertion dialog in Summernote editor, including UI setup, video node creation from URLs, and event handling.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the VideoDialog with the given editor context.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Sets up the dialog UI elements and appends it to the DOM.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Hides and removes the dialog from the DOM.

methods.name: bindEnterKey
methods.description: Binds the Enter key press event to trigger the video insertion button.

methods.name: createVideoNode
methods.description: Creates an iframe or video element based on the provided URL, supporting various video providers and formats.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the dialog, handles user input, and inserts the video node into the editor.

methods.name: showVideoDialog
methods.description: Displays the video URL input dialog and returns a promise resolving with the URL.
